G4:LA2 Benefits provided to full-time employees that are not provided to temporary 
or part-time employees, by significant locations of operation.
column4:
Part-time and contract employees have similar access to health and retirement 
benefits as full-time employees. Benefits related to life insurance, vacation, and 
tuition reimbursement are prorated for part-time employees. Contract employees are 
not eligible for a number of benefits, including long-term disability, equity incentive 
plan, and tuition reimbursement. Part-time and contract employees are not eligible 
for our sabbatical benefit.
